name: unlinked
description: Search your owner-scoped imported network and the complete published professional People index with an explicitly revocable account grant. Recovered Connections observations require the same confirmed owner; original files are browser-only and excluded from grants. Current grants add whoami, deterministic paginated listings and an explicit AI search tool; old grants keep exactly their issued tool list. The same tools are served as a grant-authenticated HTTP JSON API under /api/agent/v1/ (contract: docs/agent-api.md).

authentication.provisioning: Manual key setup: https://www.unlinked.ai/agents. Lifecycle and release contract: docs/agent-key-settings.md in the repository.

oauth.revocation: Settings → Connected apps, or RFC 7009 at /oauth/revoke

tools.name: unlinked_search_network
tools.description: Search the owner's imported network, or pass degree 1/2 plus an optional cursor to read recorded public paths from the explicitly confirmed recovered profile.

tools.name: unlinked_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated grant owner: stable Unlinked owner id, grant scope/version/tools, import count and confirmed legacy anchor if any. Linkage is the grant itself, never email matching.

tools.name: unlinked_list_people
tools.description: Deterministically list or lexically filter the published public People index. Opaque cursor, max 50 per page, total and snapshot revision. Public fields only.

tools.name: unlinked_list_connections
tools.description: Deterministically list the owner's connections. Degree 1 includes owner-imported contacts (no anchor required) plus recorded public paths when anchored; degree 2 returns only recorded public paths with the proving path, or typed degree_unproven.

tools.name: unlinked_get_profile
tools.description: Read one published public profile by id with its public connections page; typed not_found otherwise.

tools.name: unlinked_ai_search
tools.description: Explicit AI tool. scope 'mine' ranks only your own imported network; scope 'everyone' ranks the published public index and requires a public-scope grant. Owner role queries require supplied title evidence, omit domain-only matches and give short conversational reasons stating unknown sector focus. Set timeoutMs to bound latency.

tools.name: unlinked_list_connection_requests
tools.description: Read-only: list open requests; acting requires the separate explicit opt-in connection scope.

tools.name: unlinked_list_notifications
tools.description: Read-only: the owner's newest in-app notifications with unseen/unread counts. Reading does not mark anything seen or read.

tools.name: unlinked_send_connection_request
tools.description: Send a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_accept_connection_request
tools.description: Accept a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_ignore_connection_request
tools.description: Ignore a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_withdraw_connection_request
tools.description: Withdraw a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

connectionBrowsing.description: Page depth describes visible content, independently of membership. Only published connections are browsed.

publicWebSearch.scope: published professional People only; excludes private networks and contact details

alternateTransport.scope: same live canonical public page; no credentials forwarded or stored publication

messaging.agentCredential: Separate OpenChat oc_ key for messages and Context; Unlinked grants cannot send messages.

recommendedSetup.note: This server card describes the optional direct Unlinked MCP endpoint. Shared setup is the default; preserve existing direct connections.
